commands.name: get-job
commands.summary: Get one remote job posting's detail page by its category slug and job slug (the slug ends in the numeric job id).

commands.name: list-job-index-pages
commands.summary: List Remotive's browse pages for jobs by category, location, employment type, career level and posting date, e.g. /remote-jobs/l-germany, /remote-jobs/cl-senior, /remote-jobs/posted-last-24h.

dropped.name: search-jobs
dropped.reason: The live call returned no 'results' array, so resultPath results.0.hits resolved to undefined and the runtime crashed on .slice. The request targets the paid 'remotive_unlimited' index with paywallProfile 'custom', which most likely needs a logged-in paying session. No live response schema was provided to build a correct shape. Separately, the fixed facetFilters template sends empty 'category:' etc. filters when those params are omitted, which would break unfiltered searches.

dropped.name: list-job-facets
dropped.reason: This hits the same endpoint and fails the same way: the response had no 'results' array, so results.0.facets was undefined. It also uses the paywalled 'remotive_unlimited' index and paywallProfile, which likely needs a session. There is no live evidence to repair the result path.
